findings.problem: G5 split step 2.2 into 2.2a (churches/settings/fellowships) and 2.2b (admins, billing, super-admins). The Billing tab 2.3 edits is built in 2.2b, so a dependency on the non-existent id 2.2 breaks the chain at assembly.
findings.fix: Set depends_on to ["2.2b"] and change every '2.2' reference in the 2.3 prompt/inputs to '2.2b' (or '2.2a' where the churches list is meant).

findings.problem: G5's 2.2a/2.2b put the tabs in `app/(super)/admin/churches/[orgId]/layout.tsx` with each tab as a sub-route; the Billing tab is `app/(super)/admin/churches/[orgId]/billing/page.tsx` + `src/features/orgs/BillingPanel.tsx`, with Server Actions in `src/features/orgs/billing-actions.ts` and an existing banner component `src/features/orgs/StripeBanner.tsx` (keyed on `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` only). A fresh agent following 2.3 would look in the wrong file and duplicate the banner; the `success_url`/`cancel_url` in Build 6.6 also point at the Details tab instead of the Billing tab.
findings.fix: Rewrite the 2.2 input bullet: 'Step 2.2b produced `app/(super)/admin/churches/[orgId]/billing/page.tsx`, `src/features/orgs/BillingPanel.tsx`, `src/features/orgs/billing-actions.ts` (setBillingMode / trial / status actions — keep them), `src/features/orgs/billing-mode.ts`, and `src/features/orgs/StripeBanner.tsx` (banner shown when `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` is absent — reuse it and switch its condition to `stripeConfig().configured`, i.e. all three variables); step 2.2a produced the tab `layout.tsx` and `packages/db/src/queries/orgs.ts` `listOrganizationsForAdmin(client)` which already joins the latest `billing_subscriptions` row.' Change `success_url`/`cancel_url` to `${appUrl()}/admin/churches/${orgId}/billing?billing=success|cancelled` and read the search param on the billing page.

findings.quote: if it redirects on failure, add a non-redirecting sibling `getSuperAdminContext()`
findings.problem: 2.1 (G5) already exports a non-redirecting `getAuthContext()` in `src/lib/auth/context.ts` (returns `isSuperAdmin`), plus `src/lib/env.ts` with `publicEnv().appUrl` / `serverEnv()`. Inventing `getSuperAdminContext()` and `appUrl()` creates parallel helpers two agents would implement differently.
findings.fix: Replace with: 'Use `getAuthContext()` from `src/lib/auth/context.ts` (2.1) and answer 401 JSON unless `ctx?.isSuperAdmin`; only if no such helper exists add `getSuperAdminContext()` next to `requireSuperAdmin()`.' In Build 2 replace `appUrl()` with 'reuse `publicEnv().appUrl` from `src/lib/env.ts` (2.1), trimming a trailing slash; do not add a second env reader'. Drop `getSuperAdminContext()` from open_issues if adopted.

findings.problem: G2's 1.2 fixed these: `billing_customers (org_id uuid pk fk cascade, stripe_customer_id text not null unique, email citext, created_at, updated_at)` and `stripe_events` with exactly the DESIGN columns (no `org_id`). The enum is also fixed: `subscription_status (trialing, active, past_due, canceled, unpaid, incomplete, incomplete_expired, paused, none, unknown)`. Leaving these conditional forces the agent to re-derive them and leaves Build 9 as a fork.
findings.fix: State the columns and enum values verbatim (still 'verify against 9999_init.sql'); have `ensureCustomer` also store `email`; rewrite Build 9 as: '`stripe_events` has no `org_id`: show the global last 10 events on `/admin` (super admins only) and no per-org list.'

findings.quote: export `defaultDeps()` that builds it from `getStripe()` and the service client and throws `StripeNotConfiguredError`
findings.problem: Build 5 later calls `defaultWebhookDeps()` which 'must not throw', while Build 3 defines only `defaultDeps()` which throws; the webhook handler also needs a `stripe` instance for `constructEvent`, and the 503 rule only mentions the missing webhook secret.
findings.fix: Define both in Build 3: `defaultDeps()` (checkout/portal; throws `StripeNotConfiguredError` when unconfigured) and `defaultWebhookDeps()` → `{ stripe: getStripe(), webhookSecret: process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET ?? '', db: service client }` never throwing; in Build 4 return 503 `webhook_not_configured` when `webhookSecret` is empty OR `deps.stripe` is null.

findings.problem: `grep -v server-only` filters matching lines, not files, so it never removes anything (the env read and the `import 'server-only'` are on different lines); the check as written is meaningless.
findings.fix: Replace with: `grep -rln "STRIPE_" apps/web/app apps/web/src` → every hit is `src/lib/stripe/*.ts`, a Route Handler, or a server component file; none is a file containing `'use client'` (`grep -l "use client" $(grep -rln STRIPE_ apps/web/app apps/web/src)` → empty).

findings.quote: `pnpm --filter web dev` with the mock env, then: `curl …`
findings.problem: The curl sequence needs the dev server running in the background with `apps/web/.env.local` holding `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000` (otherwise the origin check can never pass and the 401 case cannot be reached); the prompt does not say so, nor to stop the server afterwards.
findings.fix: Add: 'copy `apps/web/.env.example` to `apps/web/.env.local` with the mock values and `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000`; start `pnpm --filter web dev` in the background, run the curls, then stop it.' Also note that on Vercel Preview deployments the origin check returns 403 by design because `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` is the production URL.

findings.quote: define `BillingRepo` in `sync.ts` with a Supabase-backed implementation and let tests pass a Map-backed one
findings.problem: All tests exercise the Map-backed repo; the Supabase-backed implementation (the code that runs in production) is never executed, so a wrong table/column name compiles only if the generated types catch it.
findings.fix: Add to Build 11: 'the Supabase-backed `BillingRepo` must be typed against `Database` from `@church/db` (no `any`), and the manual check in Verify includes pressing Start subscription with `billing_mode = stripe` and confirming the 503 `stripe_not_configured` JSON — proving the route wiring — plus a one-off local script or test that runs the Supabase repo against the local DB (`DATABASE_URL`) if a service-role client can be built there; otherwise record in HANDOFF that the repo is verified only in 3.9.'

findings.quote: select count(*) as tables from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'public';                   -- 38
findings.problem: `information_schema.tables` includes views; `public` holds the 38 tables plus the three views `directory_households`, `directory_persons`, `org_directory_info`, so the query returns 41 and the founder would conclude the paste failed. The same wrong expectation is in done_when item 2.
findings.fix: Change the query to `select count(*) as tables from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'public' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE'; -- 38` and add `select count(*) as views from information_schema.views where table_schema = 'public'; -- 3`.

findings.quote: Exact expected counts are in `supabase/README.md` (section "Hosted verification")
findings.problem: G3's 1.5 prompt defines the README sections (What is in this folder; First-time production bootstrap; Adding a migration; Free plan notes; Running the RLS tests against the hosted project; Local development; Never) — there is no 'Hosted verification' section and no measured counts, so the founder is sent to a section that does not exist. The hard-coded `> 60` policies and `7 srv_*` are also guesses (1.3b may have added `srv_*` functions).
findings.fix: Either (a) add to open_issues a cross-group request that 1.5 append a 'Hosted verification' section to `supabase/README.md` with the five queries and the numbers measured locally, or (b) make 2.4 self-sufficient: add a 'pre-paste' mode to the helper prompt — 'before I paste, run `scripts/db/local-up.sh && scripts/db/apply-migrations.sh` and print the results of these five queries against the local DB; I write them beside the queries in this checklist' — and replace the fixed numbers with 'must equal the local numbers from the helper'. Apply the same to done_when item 2.

findings.quote: If the orchestrator adopted the optional dry-run step 1.8, do it first
findings.problem: The founder reads docs/TODO.md, not the drafting kit; 'the orchestrator adopted' is meaningless to him.
findings.fix: Replace with 'If docs/TODO.md contains a step 1.8 (throwaway-project dry run), do it first'.

findings.quote: change `billing_mode` to `free` and back to `manual`; press Suspend → status `suspended`; Unsuspend → back
findings.problem: Per G5 2.2b, switching to `free` sets `status = 'active'` and clears `trial_ends_at`; switching back to `manual` does not restore them. After this sequence the church is `active` with no trial end, 'Unsuspend → back' returns to `active`, and done_when item 7 ('status `trial` … `trial_ends_at` about 30 days out') can no longer be true — the founder would think the app lost his data.
findings.fix: Reorder 11.5: 'press Suspend → `suspended`; Unsuspend → back to `trial`; Checkout/Portal buttons disabled with the 2.3 tooltip. Then, on a SECOND throwaway church created for this purpose (or accepting the change), switch `billing_mode` to `free` → status becomes `active` and Trial ends shows “—” (2.2b behaviour: free never expires); switch back to `manual` → the trial is not restored — set a new trial date by hand if you want one.' Update done_when item 7 accordingly.

findings.quote: sign in as that user in a private window → the "no church" screen is replaced by the church
findings.problem: At 2.5 the org pages do not exist: 2.1 ships only `app/(org)/o/page.tsx`, a placeholder listing the user's churches with a link to `/o/<slug>/dashboard` that 404s until 3.1. The founder is told to expect a church screen that cannot appear and would file a false failure with 2.6. Step 9's 'no church yet screen' is the same page with an empty list.
findings.fix: Step 9: 'you land on `/o` (the 2.1 placeholder) with an empty church list — correct, you are nobody's member yet'. Step 11.4: 'sign in as that user in a private window → `/o` lists the church with a link labelled “Church admin area arrives in step 3.1” (clicking it 404s for now — expected).' Also after accepting the invitation: 'you are redirected to `/o`, which now lists the church.'

findings.problem: `/s/[token]` is built in 3.4; at 2.5 the URL returns Next's generic 404 page. Status 404 is right, the description is not.
findings.fix: Change to '`/s/unknown` returns the generic 404 page (status 404; the share page arrives in 3.4)'.

findings.problem: 2.1's done_when calls them 'Password and Email-code tabs'; the founder will look for a tab literally labelled 'Code (OTP)'.
findings.fix: Write '`/login` shows two tabs, Password and Email code (6-digit OTP)'.

findings.quote: not for any second admin created directly with another address unless that address is also a Supabase team member
findings.problem: The open issue is wrong: 'Create account directly' calls `auth.admin.createUser({ email_confirm: true })` (2.2b), so no email is sent and built-in SMTP limits do not apply to the second admin. Only the founder's own `/signup` confirmation and OTP mails depend on SMTP at Checkpoint A.
findings.fix: Rewrite that open issue: 'Built-in SMTP delivers only to Supabase team members: the founder's own sign-up confirmation is fine; invited (not directly created) admins with other addresses need Resend or custom SMTP, scheduled for 3.9.' Add one line to checklist 11.4: 'no email is sent for directly created accounts — hand over the temporary password yourself.'

findings.quote: Share page `/s/<token>` 404 for a valid link | `SHARE_LINK_COOKIE_SECRET` changed (cookies invalid) or org disabled sharing
findings.problem: Rotating the cookie secret only invalidates unlock cookies — visitors see the password form again, not a 404. Mixing the two misleads the diagnosis.
findings.fix: Split into two rows: '`/s/<token>` 404 for a link that worked | link revoked/expired/`max_views` reached, sermon unpublished, or `organization_settings.sermons_shareable` off | check `sermon_share_links` and the setting' and '`/s/<token>` asks for the password again | `SHARE_LINK_COOKIE_SECRET` rotated | expected; users unlock again'.

findings.quote: a Playwright smoke assertion in `apps/web/e2e/smoke.spec.ts` (mock env; create the file if 3.7 has not yet)
findings.problem: No Playwright config exists before 3.7 (2.1 explicitly does not use Playwright); creating the harness inside a triage run is scope creep and two agents would set it up differently.
findings.fix: Change to 'a Playwright smoke assertion in `apps/web/e2e/smoke.spec.ts` only if `apps/web/playwright.config.ts` already exists (3.7); otherwise a Vitest test or a CI check'.

findings.problem: The agent cannot see Vercel; it has no way to know which variable names are set there unless the founder pastes them. Several symptom rows (missing/mis-named env) also hinge on that list.
